description.value: The Earl Mah Aquatic Center is Prince Rupert's municipally operated public swimming facility, housed in a two-storey building on McBride Street and managed by the City of Prince Rupert Recreation Department. It serves as the community's primary aquatic venue in one of BC's northernmost coastal cities, a significant waypoint for cyclists arriving by BC Ferries from the south. Specific cyclist-friendly amenities are not documented in available online sources.
